ITEM 1 | Fresh raw leafy greens, dark green spinach-like leaves with some red-stemmed leaves and pale green stem pieces, covering roughly the left third of the plate in a loose heap, matte surface, slightly moist, leaves about 5-8 cm long | 60
ITEM 2 | Flatbread-like wedge, pale tan with golden-brown char spots and grill marks along the edges, dry matte surface, folded or triangular piece about 10 cm by 7 cm, sitting to the right of the greens and about 1 cm thick | 55
ITEM 3 | Cooked vegetable filling, pale green zucchini-like slices with light browning and soft texture, mixed with bright red pepper strips, glossy with slight oil sheen, piled on the flatbread about 6 cm by 4 cm and 1 cm high | 40
ITEM 4 | Thin red-orange pepper strips, bright glossy red with slight softness, scattered over the greens and filling, each strip about 4-6 cm long and 0.5 cm wide | 10
ITEM 5 | Light oily sheen on the filling and flatbread surface, visible as a slight glisten, no pooled sauce | 3
